title.suggested: Andrew Carlson Recalls Allen's Fights With McCoole and Gallagher

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat quoted Andrew Carlson of New Orleans, who recalled seeing Tom Allen fight Mike McCoole down the river and Charley Gallagher beat Allen in three rounds near Chester, Ill.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, April 6, 1893, page 7.

facts.fact: Andrew Carlson recalled seeing Allen fight Mike McCoole down the river from St. Louis by steamboat
Andrew Carlson recalled seeing Charley Gallagher beat Allen in three rounds somewhere near Chester, Illinois

notes: Secondhand recollection decades later; the three rounds and Chester location may not match the record of the 1869 Gallagher fight.
